projects.title: Chat Microservice - Real-Time Messaging Platform
projects.description: Engineered a horizontally-scalable chat system supporting 100k+ concurrent users with distributed state management.
keyFeatures: Real-time presence tracking and notifications via Redis Pub/Sub
Distributed load balancing across multiple instances with sticky sessions
GraphQL subscription APIs for real-time data synchronization
projects.impact: Enabled seamless real-time communication at scale for a global user base.

caseStudy.problemStatement: Need to support 100k+ concurrent users with low latency and global presence management while maintaining message ordering and consistency.
caseStudy.solutionArchitecture: Decoupled messaging architecture using WebSocket for bi-directional communication, Redis Pub/Sub for cross-node presence broadcasting, and GraphQL subscriptions for schema-driven real-time updates.
decisions: Redis Pub/Sub for presence to handle cross-node communication
Horizontal scaling with Docker & ECS to manage traffic bursts
MongoDB for message persistence with TTL-based archiving
caseStudy.results: Achieved sub-100ms latency across geographic regions with 99.9% uptime and zero message loss during peak loads.
caseStudy.architectureDetails: The system uses a 'Fan-out' pattern for message distribution. Load balancers use consistent hashing to route users to the nearest node, while Redis acts as the central orchestrator for state synchronization across the cluster.

projects.title: Multi-Tenant Slot Booking Platform
projects.description: Enterprise SaaS platform with strict multi-tenancy, data isolation, and distributed locking.
keyFeatures: Row-level security and per-client data segregation at the database layer
Optimistic concurrency control with versioning to prevent double-bookings
Dynamic slot allocation engine with time-zone aware scheduling
Razorpay payment integration with automated payouts and ledger reconciliation
projects.impact: Provided a reliable foundation for B2B clients to manage thousands of bookings daily across multiple regions.

caseStudy.problemStatement: Building a SaaS that requires strict data isolation between tenants while allowing a shared resource pool and preventing race conditions during high-volume booking periods.
caseStudy.solutionArchitecture: Adopted a 'Shared Schema, Discriminator Column' approach for cost-efficiency with logical isolation via middleware. Implemented distributed locking using Redis for critical booking sections.
decisions: Logical isolation via tenant_id middleware for performance
Distributed locks for the booking transaction to prevent race conditions
Webhook-based payment reconciliation to ensure eventual consistency
caseStudy.results: Zero reported overbooking incidents in production over 2 years and sub-second tenant data access.
caseStudy.architectureDetails: The architecture follows a Layered (N-Tier) design with a dedicated 'Tenant Context' provider in the request pipeline, ensuring that every database query is automatically scoped to the current tenant.

projects.title: Transportation & Freight Booking Platform
projects.description: Mission-critical logistics platform with real-time IoT tracking, automated settlements, and complex role-based access control.
keyFeatures: Granular RBAC for Loaders, Truckers, and Fleet Managers
SIM-based GPS tracking via Traqo API integration
Automated payment settlement pipeline from booking to delivery
Comprehensive Admin dashboard for fleet monitoring and financial reconciliation
projects.impact: Digitized traditional freight operations, significantly reducing manual overhead and increasing transparency.

caseStudy.problemStatement: Modernizing a legacy logistics process with real-time tracking and secure financial settlements across multiple stakeholders with varying access levels.
caseStudy.solutionArchitecture: Modular monolith architecture with a robust Event Bus for internal communication. Integrated IoT APIs for live vehicle status and implemented a custom state machine for booking lifecycles.
decisions: State Machine for booking status to prevent illegal transitions
Integration with SIM-based GPS for high reliability in remote areas
Delayed settlement logic to allow for dispute resolution
caseStudy.results: Reduced manual coordination time by 40% and improved payment reconciliation accuracy by 98%.
caseStudy.architectureDetails: The platform utilizes a 'State-Machine' pattern to manage the complex lifecycle of a freight booking. Each status transition triggers specific events (notifications, ledger entries) via an internal event emitter.

projects.title: CCM — Construction & Contractor Management
projects.description: End-to-end real estate project lifecycle platform with role-based access for 5 stakeholder types, covering inspection workflows, financial pipeline (Quotation → Job → Invoice), contractor time & expense tracking, and role-aware analytics dashboards.

impactMetrics.label: Cross-role data leakage via server-enforced RBAC
Manual coordination replaced by automated reminders

projects.impact: Unified all project actors into a single platform, eliminating manual coordination and increasing accountability.

caseStudy.problemStatement: Construction and real estate project management involves many moving parts — clients, contractors, inspectors, and admin teams — often operating in silos. Manual coordination of inspections, financial approvals, and scheduling leads to delays, lost accountability, and opaque billing cycles. CCM was built to unify all these actors under a single platform: giving each role exactly the data and actions they need, while maintaining a strict audit trail from project creation through to final invoice.
caseStudy.solutionArchitecture: CCM provides each role exactly the data and actions they need, while maintaining a strict audit trail from project creation through to final invoice. It is built on a structured RESTful API in Node.js backed by PostgreSQL, with React on the frontend consuming role-scoped API responses.
caseStudy.architectureDetails: Data visibility is enforced server-side — each API endpoint validates the requesting user's role before returning or mutating data, ensuring that role-based restrictions cannot be bypassed through frontend manipulation.
decisions: Server-side RBAC enforcement — Role permissions are validated at the API layer, not relying on frontend routing guards alone.
Linked financial entities — Quotation, Job, and Invoice share foreign key relationships in PostgreSQL, maintaining referential integrity across the billing pipeline.
Role-scoped dashboard queries — Dashboard aggregations (weekly / monthly / yearly) are computed server-side per role, minimising data over-fetching to the client.
Scheduling as a first-class module — Reminders are modelled as independent entities associated with projects, activities, and target roles — supporting flexible multi-stakeholder scheduling.
Inspection-to-quotation traceability — Inspection reports carry a direct reference to the project, enabling admins to scope quotations with full inspection context available in the same UI.
caseStudy.results: Unified 5 distinct stakeholder roles, linked 3 core financial stages end-to-end, and eliminated cross-role data leakage via server-enforced RBAC.

systemRoles.name: Super Admin
systemRoles.description: Platform-level control. Manages admin accounts and global configuration.

systemRoles.name: Admin
systemRoles.description: Core operator. Manages clients, projects, quotations, jobs, and invoices.

systemRoles.name: Inspector
systemRoles.description: Site-level actor. Conducts inspections and submits detailed inspection reports.

systemRoles.name: Contractor
systemRoles.description: Executes jobs. Logs time and expense entries against assigned jobs.

systemRoles.name: Client
systemRoles.description: End recipient. Views project progress, inspection reports, and receives invoices.

coreWorkflow.title: Client & Project Onboarding
coreWorkflow.description: Admin creates a client profile and registers the real estate project, linking it to the client for full traceability.

coreWorkflow.title: Site Inspection
coreWorkflow.description: Inspector visits the site and submits a structured inspection report, which is accessible to the admin and client.

coreWorkflow.title: Quotation
coreWorkflow.description: Admin creates a quotation based on inspection findings, scoping the cost of work before committing resources.

coreWorkflow.title: Job Assignment
coreWorkflow.description: Admin converts an approved quotation into a job and assigns it to a contractor with defined scope and timelines.

coreWorkflow.title: Time & Expense Logging
coreWorkflow.description: Contractor logs hours worked and expenses incurred against the job, building a complete cost record in real time.

coreWorkflow.title: Invoice Generation & Delivery
coreWorkflow.description: Admin generates a final invoice from the job record and dispatches it directly to the client through the platform.

featureModules.title: Role-Aware Dashboard
featureModules.description: Each role sees contextual analytics — job status, invoice totals, and quote summaries — filterable by weekly, monthly, and yearly ranges.

featureModules.title: Inspection Reports
featureModules.description: Inspectors submit structured site reports with findings. Reports are linked to projects and inform quotation scoping.

featureModules.title: Financial Pipeline
featureModules.description: A connected Quotation → Job → Invoice flow ensures no billing step is skipped and amounts are always traceable to source work.

featureModules.title: Contractor Time & Expense
featureModules.description: Contractors log granular time entries and expenses per job, giving admins full visibility into actual vs. estimated costs.

featureModules.title: Schedule & Reminders
featureModules.description: Admin sets activity-specific reminders for inspectors, contractors, and clients via the scheduling module — reducing missed deadlines.

featureModules.title: Project–Client Linkage
featureModules.description: Every project is bound to a single client, ensuring data scoping and preventing cross-client information leakage.
